title: Vendor Invoice Audit Decision Table: Days Owed to a Partner Agency under Cardinal Rental Reimbursement
content:
Under Cardinal Rental Reimbursement, the days owed to an agency on its latest agency payment, meaning the days the agency should have been paid for, follow the authorization that payment bills. The figures are read from the claim's rental ledger:
- the payment's billed days;
- the authorization's authorized days, with every extension;
- the closing allowance owed to the agency;
- the closing span, which runs from the authorization's start date through its closing end date, both days included.

| Billed days compared with authorized days plus the closing allowance owed | The authorization has a closing whose span is shorter than the billed days | Days owed to the agency |
|---|---|---|
| More | — | The authorized days plus the closing allowance owed |
| Within (equal or fewer) | Yes | The closing span |
| Within (equal or fewer) | No, or no closing on the ledger | The billed days |

## Audit cases (hypothetical payments)

| Billed days | Authorized days | Closing allowance owed | Closing span | Days owed |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 14 | 12 | 1 | 14 | 13 |
| 12 | 12 | 1 | 10 | 10 |
| 12 | 12 | 1 | 12 | 12 |
| 12 | 12 | 0 | No closing | 12 |
| 13 | 12 | 1 | 9 | 9 |

In the last line, 13 billed days is not more than 12 plus 1, so the first row does not apply. The closing span of 9 is shorter than 13, so the days owed are 9.
